headlineClaims.title: Read app-host artifacts over parallel range requests
headlineClaims.population: Seven app-host product consumers in a full-suite run
headlineClaims.note: The baseline was about eight minutes per consumer; the PR reports the transfer step as roughly 98 percent transport time and moves the path to concurrent ranges with verification and fallback.

headlineClaims.title: Compile the E2E test product once and reuse it on reruns
headlineClaims.population: Reruns of a failed focused E2E dispatch while the retained product remains available
headlineClaims.note: Fresh dispatches do not claim lower total runner minutes; this figure is the measured compile portion removed from a rerun by the new job split.

headlineClaims.title: Report recorded failures even when app-host results are incomplete
headlineClaims.population: Recorded XCTest and Swift Testing failures in the incomplete app-host shards
headlineClaims.note: The fix changes diagnostics, not the fail-closed verdict: incomplete runs remain failed while recorded failures are now named.

headlineClaims.title: Debounce macOS admission on superseded pull-request pushes
headlineClaims.population: Superseded pull-request runs that would otherwise start macOS work
headlineClaims.note: Replay estimate at the default 180-second delay; the same analysis measured a 1.4-minute median increase to the green signal.

headlineClaims.title: Route pull-request macOS jobs to sponsored capacity
headlineClaims.population: Pull-request macOS overflow work in the sampled CMUX CI day
headlineClaims.note: This moves workload onto sponsored capacity; it does not claim the compute disappeared.

headlineClaims.title: Seed compilation cache on the runner pull requests restore from
headlineClaims.population: Pull-request admission before the cache producer and consumer runner layouts matched
headlineClaims.note: The PR explicitly left warm compile time unmeasured until the next scheduled seed.

headlineClaims.title: Seed the Debug compilation cache from main
headlineClaims.population: macOS compile admission from an empty compilation cache
headlineClaims.note: The PR deliberately did not quote an unmeasured CI savings number before the scheduled seed had run.

accountingRule: Only claims explicitly marked additive are summed. Baselines, capacity shifts, overlapping savings, and projections stay separate.
